leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and manage checkout state using JavaScript objects and variables.
Implement a function to save the checkout state to the browser's localStorage.
Construct a function to retrieve and restore the checkout state from localStorage on page load.
Apply conditional logic to validate and update the restored checkout state before use.
Integrate state recovery functions into a simulated checkout flow event handler.
Manipulate the DOM to display the restored checkout state to the user.
Configure a basic user interface to trigger and test the state recovery process.
lessonTitle: Build resilient checkout state recovery flow
